scopeChanges: Existing staff assisted checkout and on-site doorstep flow were audited and retained; neither already supplied this feature.
A supplementary request has its own immutable audit reference but merges into the original fulfilment; it never creates a free independent shipment.
Safe limit is one supplementary request before assignment/loading, stricter than departure. Financially committed orders use the established correction process.
Unpaid card orders can be extended before payment preparation, without any staff-initiated payment; existing customer card verification remains mandatory. No provider flags changed.
